title: Defined support coverage including peak periods
objective: Guarantee reachable support during business hours and for critical severity at all times, with added coverage at year-end and an out-of-band channel.
owner: Proposed: Customer Support Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Severity-based response targets measured from ticket data
objective: Classify every case by defined severity and measure response and resolution against targets automatically.
owner: Proposed: Customer Support Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Escalation path with backup for each contact
objective: Ensure every escalation level resolves to a reachable person and a named backup.
owner: Proposed: Customer Support Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Customer-approved, time-boxed support access
objective: Deny support staff and agents access to tenant data by default; grant scoped, expiring, customer-approved access, record every action and show it in the customer's access view. Emergency access is two-person break-glass limited to read and protective actions.
owner: Proposed: Security Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Bounded AI support agents with human escalation
objective: Disclose AI support, restrict agents to read-only knowledge and the requesting user's authorized data, forbid financial or authority actions, and route to a human on request or on defined triggers.
owner: Proposed: Customer Support Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Problem management
objective: Group recurring incidents into problems, track root cause and fixes, and communicate known errors to affected customers.
owner: Proposed: Customer Support Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Support location and subcontracting disclosure
objective: Maintain and disclose where support is provided from and whether by employees or subcontractors.
owner: Proposed: Customer Support Lead (role not yet staffed)
